summary: The strongest listening paper in this group: all four parts are full length (650-920 words), the distractors are exactly the real IELTS kind, and every answer key is correct and in order. Nothing needed fixing.
strengths: Part 1 has a distractor for almost every gap (2nd -> 9th October, 30 -> 45 boxes, 950 Saturday price vs 800 weekday, 8.00 depot vs 8.30 arrival).
Part 2 MCQs and the matching task mention rejected details for most options (fish market, ferry terminal; touch pool, tunnel; research grant, plain architecture).
Part 3 is a long, natural discussion (about 920 words) in which every rejected option is argued away with a reason.
Part 4 is a real academic lecture with a myth-busting structure (sand vs parasite) and a spelled technical term (nacre).

issues.problem: Q28 'foreign backpackers' is said in the script with the same words as the option, so it carries no paraphrase; Q27's day-trippers does.
issues.change: None needed for the test; one plain match in a pair is normal.
